v.t: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the Verses of the Clear Book
v.l: Alif-Lam-Ra Tilka 'Ayatu Al-Kitabi Al-Mubini

v.t: We have revealed it an Arabic Quran, so that you may understand
v.l: Inna 'Anzalnahu Qur'anaan `Arabiyaan La`allakum Ta`qiluna

v.t: We narrate to you the most accurate history, by revealing to you this Quran. Although, prior to it, you were of the unaware
v.l: Nahnu Naqussu `Alayka 'Ahsana Al-Qasasi Bima 'Awhayna 'Ilayka Hadha Al-Qur'ana Wa 'In Kunta Min Qablihi Lamina Al-Ghafilina

v.t: When Joseph said to his father, “O my father, I saw eleven planets, and the sun, and the moon; I saw them bowing down to me.”
v.l: Idh Qala Yusufu Li'abihi Ya 'Abati 'Inni Ra'aytu 'Ahada `Ashara Kawkabaan Wa Ash-Shamsa Wa Al-Qamara Ra'aytuhum Li Sajidina

v.t: He said, “O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers, lest they plot and scheme against you. Satan is man's sworn enemy
v.l: Qala Ya Bunayya La Taqsus Ru'uya Ka `Ala 'Ikhwatika Fayakidu Laka Kaydaan 'Inna Ash-Shaytana Lil'insani `Aduwun Mubinun

v.t: And thus your Lord will choose you, and will teach you the interpretation of events, and will complete His blessing upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He has completed it before upon your forefathers Abraham and Isaac. Your Lord is Knowing and Wise
v.l: Wa Kadhalika Yajtabika Rabbuka Wa Yu`allimuka Min Ta'wili Al-'Ahadithi Wa Yutimmu Ni`matahu `Alayka Wa `Ala 'Ali Ya`quba Kama 'Atammaha `Ala 'Abawayka Min Qablu 'Ibrahima Wa 'Ishaqa 'Inna Rabbaka `Alimun Hakimun

v.t: In Joseph and his brothers are lessons for the seekers
v.l: Laqad Kana Fi Yusufa Wa 'Ikhwatihi 'Ayatun Lilssa'ilina

v.t: When they said, “Joseph and his brother are dearer to our father than we are, although we are a whole group. Our father is obviously in the wrong
v.l: Idh Qalu Layusufu Wa 'Akhuhu 'Ahabbu 'Ila 'Abina Minna Wa Nahnu `Usbatun 'Inna 'Abana Lafi Đalalin Mubinin

v.t: “Kill Joseph, or throw him somewhere in the land, and your father‘s attention will be yours. Afterwards, you will be decent people.”
v.l: Aqtulu Yusufa 'Awi Atrahuhu 'Arđaan Yakhlu Lakum Wajhu 'Abikum Wa Takunu Min Ba`dihi Qawmaan Salihina

v.t: One of them said, “Do not kill Joseph, but throw him into the bottom of the well; some caravan may pick him up—if you must do something.”
v.l: Qala Qa'ilun Minhum La Taqtulu Yusufa Wa 'Alquhu Fi Ghayabati Al-Jubbi Yaltaqithu Ba`đu As-Sayyarati 'In Kuntum Fa`ilina

v.t: They said, “Father, why do you not trust us with Joseph, although we care for him?”
v.l: Qalu Ya 'Abana Ma Laka La Ta'manna `Ala Yusufa Wa 'Inna Lahu Lanasihuna

v.t: “Send him with us tomorrow, that he may roam and play; we will take care of him.”
v.l: Arsilhu Ma`ana Ghadaan Yarta` Wa Yal`ab Wa 'Inna Lahu Lahafizuna

v.t: He said, “It worries me that you would take him away. And I fear the wolf may eat him while you are careless of him.”
v.l: Qala 'Inni Layahzununi 'An Tadh/habu Bihi Wa 'Akhafu 'An Ya'kulahu Adh-Dhi'bu Wa 'Antum `Anhu Ghafiluna

v.t: They said, “If the wolf ate him, and we are many, we would be good for nothing.”
v.l: Qalu La'in 'Akalahu Adh-Dhi'bu Wa Nahnu `Usbatun 'Inna 'Idhaan Lakhasiruna

v.t: So they went away with him, and agreed to put him at the bottom of the well. And We inspired him, “You will inform them of this deed of theirs when they are unaware.”
v.l: Falamma Dhahabu Bihi Wa 'Ajma`u 'An Yaj`aluhu Fi Ghayabati Al-Jubbi Wa 'Awhayna 'Ilayhi Latunabbi'annahum Bi'amrihim Hadha Wa Hum La Yash`uruna

v.t: And they came to their father in the evening weeping
v.l: Wa Ja'u 'Abahum `Isha'an Yabkuna

v.t: They said, “O father, we went off racing one another, and left Joseph by our belongings; and the wolf ate him. But you will not believe us, even though we are being truthful.”
v.l: Qalu Ya 'Abana 'Inna Dhahabna Nastabiqu Wa Tarakna Yusufa `Inda Mata`ina Fa'akalahu Adh-Dhi'bu Wa Ma 'Anta Bimu'uminin Lana Wa Law Kunna Sadiqina

v.t: And they brought his shirt, with fake blood on it. He said, “Your souls enticed you to do something. But patience is beautiful, and God is my Help against what you describe.”
v.l: Wa Ja'u `Ala Qamisihi Bidamin Kadhibin Qala Bal Sawwalat Lakum 'Anfusukum 'Amraan Fasabrun Jamilun Wa Allahu Al-Musta`anu `Ala Ma Tasifuna

v.t: A caravan passed by, and they sent their water-carrier. He lowered his bucket, and said, “Good news. Here is a boy.” And they hid him as merchandise. But God was aware of what they did
v.l: Wa Ja'at Sayyaratun Fa'arsalu Wa Aridahum Fa'adla Dalwahu Qala Ya Bushra Hadha Ghulamun Wa 'Asarruhu Biđa`atan Wa Allahu `Alimun Bima Ya`maluna

v.t: And they sold him for a cheap price—a few coins—they considered him to be of little value
v.l: Wa Sharawhu Bithamanin Bakhsin Darahima Ma`dudatin Wa Kanu Fihi Mina Az-Zahidina

v.t: The Egyptian who bought him said to his wife, “Take good care of him; he may be useful to us, or we may adopt him as a son.” We thus established Joseph in the land, to teach him the interpretation of events. God has control over His affairs, but most people do not know
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhi Ashtarahu Min Misra Li'imra'atihi 'Akrimi Mathwahu `Asa 'An Yanfa`ana 'Aw Nattakhidhahu Waladaan Wa Kadhalika Makkanna Liyusufa Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Linu`allimahu Min Ta'wili Al-'Ahadithi Wa Allahu Ghalibun `Ala 'Amrihi Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Ya`lamuna

v.t: When he reached his maturity, We gave him wisdom and knowledge. We thus reward the righteous
v.l: Wa Lamma Balagha 'Ashuddahu 'Ataynahu Hukmaan Wa `Ilmaan Wa Kadhalika Najzi Al-Muhsinina

v.t: She in whose house he was living tried to seduce him. She shut the doors, and said, “I am yours.” He said, “God forbid! He is my Lord. He has given me a good home. Sinners never succeed.”
v.l: Wa Rawadat/hu Allati Huwa Fi Baytiha `An Nafsihi Wa Ghallaqati Al-'Abwaba Wa Qalat Hayta Laka Qala Ma`adha Allahi 'Innahu Rabbi 'Ahsana Mathwaya 'Innahu La Yuflihu Az-Zalimuna

v.t: She desired him, and he desired her, had he not seen the proof of his Lord. It was thus that We diverted evil and indecency away from him. He was one of Our loyal servants
v.l: Wa Laqad Hammat Bihi Wa Hamma Biha Lawla 'An Ra'a Burhana Rabbihi Kadhalika Linasrifa `Anhu As-Su'a Wa Al-Fahsha'a 'Innahu Min `Ibadina Al-Mukhlasina

v.t: As they raced towards the door, she tore his shirt from behind. At the door, they ran into her husband. She said, “What is the penalty for him who desired to dishonor your wife, except imprisonment or a painful punishment?”
v.l: Wa Astabaqa Al-Baba Wa Qaddat Qamisahu Min Duburin Wa 'Alfaya Sayyidaha Lada Al-Babi Qalat Ma Jaza'u Man 'Arada Bi'ahlika Su'aan 'Illa 'An Yusjana 'Aw `Adhabun 'Alimun

v.t: He said, “It was she who tried to seduce me.” A witness from her household suggested: “If his shirt is torn from the front: then she has told the truth, and he is the liar
v.l: Qala Hiya Rawadatni `An Nafsi Wa Shahida Shahidun Min 'Ahliha 'In Kana Qamisuhu Qudda Min Qubulin Fasadaqat Wa Huwa Mina Al-Kadhibina
w: then she has spoken the truth

v.t: But if his shirt is torn from the back: then she has lied, and he is the truthful.”
v.l: Wa 'In Kana Qamisuhu Qudda Min Duburin Fakadhabat Wa Huwa Mina As-Sadiqina

v.t: And when he saw that his shirt was torn from the back, he said, “This is a woman's scheme. Your scheming is serious indeed.”
v.l: Falamma Ra'a Qamisahu Qudda Min Duburin Qala 'Innahu Min Kaydikunna 'Inna Kaydakunna `Azimun

v.t: “Joseph, turn away from this. And you, woman, ask forgiveness for your sin; you are indeed in the wrong.”
v.l: Yusufu 'A`riđ `An Hadha Wa Astaghfiri Lidhanbiki 'Innaki Kunti Mina Al-Khati'ina

v.t: Some ladies in the city said, “The governor's wife is trying to seduce her servant. She is deeply in love with him. We see she has gone astray.”
v.l: Wa Qala Niswatun Fi Al-Madinati Amra'atu Al-`Azizi Turawidu Fataha `An Nafsihi Qad Shaghafaha Hubbaan 'Inna Lanaraha Fi Đalalin Mubinin

v.t: And when she heard of their gossip, she invited them, and prepared for them a banquet, and she gave each one of them a knife. She said, “Come out before them.” And when they saw him, they marveled at him, and cut their hands. They said, “Good God, this is not a human, this must be a precious angel.”
v.l: Falamma Sami`at Bimakrihinna 'Arsalat 'Ilayhinna Wa 'A`tadat Lahunna Muttaka'an Wa 'Atat Kulla Wahidatin Minhunna Sikkinaan Wa Qalati Akhruj `Alayhinna Falamma Ra'aynahu 'Akbarnahu Wa Qatta`na 'Aydiyahunna Wa Qulna Hasha Lillahi Ma Hadha Basharaan 'In Hadha 'Illa Malakun Karimun

v.t: She said, “Here he is, the one you blamed me for. I did try to seduce him, but he resisted. But if he does not do what I tell him to do, he will be imprisoned, and will be one of the despised.”
v.l: Qalat Fadhalikunna Al-Ladhi Lumtunnani Fihi Wa Laqad Rawadttuhu `An Nafsihi Fasta`sama Wa La'in Lam Yaf`al Ma 'Amuruhu Layusjananna Wa Layakunaan Mina As-Saghirina

v.t: He said, “My Lord, prison is more desirable to me than what they call me to. Unless You turn their scheming away from me, I may yield to them, and become one of the ignorant.”
v.l: Qala Rabbi As-Sijnu 'Ahabbu 'Ilayya Mimma Yad`unani 'Ilayhi Wa 'Illa Tasrif `Anni Kaydahunna 'Asbu 'Ilayhinna Wa 'Akun Mina Al-Jahilina

v.t: Thereupon his Lord answered him, and diverted their scheming away from him. He is the Hearer, the Knower
v.l: Fastajaba Lahu Rabbuhu Fasarafa `Anhu Kaydahunna 'Innahu Huwa As-Sami`u Al-`Alimu

v.t: Then it occurred to them, after they had seen the signs, to imprison him for a while
v.l: Thumma Bada Lahum Min Ba`di Ma Ra'aw Al-'Ayati Layasjununnahu Hatta Hinin

v.t: Two youth entered the prison with him. One of them said, “I see myself pressing wine.” The other said, “I see myself carrying bread on my head, from which the birds are eating. Tell us their interpretation—we see that you are one of the righteous.”
v.l: Wa Dakhala Ma`ahu As-Sijna Fatayani Qala 'Ahaduhuma 'Inni 'Arani 'A`siru Khamraan Wa Qala Al-'Akharu 'Inni 'Arani 'Ahmilu Fawqa Ra'si Khubzaan Ta'kulu At-Tayru Minhu Nabbi'na Bita'wilihi 'Inna Naraka Mina Al-Muhsinina

v.t: He said, “No food is served to you, but I have informed you about it before you have received it. That is some of what my Lord has taught me. I have forsaken the tradition of people who do not believe in God; and regarding the Hereafter, they are deniers.”
v.l: Qala La Ya'tikuma Ta`amun Turzaqanihi 'Illa Nabba'tukuma Bita'wilihi Qabla 'An Ya'tiyakuma Dhalikuma Mimma `Allamani Rabbi 'Inni Taraktu Millata Qawmin La Yu'uminuna Billahi Wa Hum Bil-'Akhirati Hum Kafiruna
w: I will inform both of you

v.t: “And I have followed the faith of my forefathers, Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob. It is not for us to associate anything with God. This is by virtue of God’s grace upon us and upon the people, but most people do not give thanks
v.l: Wa Attaba`tu Millata 'Aba'i 'Ibrahima Wa 'Ishaqa Wa Ya`quba Ma Kana Lana 'An Nushrika Billahi Min Shay'in Dhalika Min Fađli Allahi `Alayna Wa `Ala An-Nasi Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Yashkuruna

v.t: “O My fellow inmates, are diverse lords better, or God, the One, the Supreme?”
v.l: Ya Sahibayi As-Sijni 'A'arbabun Mutafarriquna Khayrun 'Ami Allahu Al-Wahidu Al-Qahharu

v.t: “You do not worship, besides Him, except names you have named, you and your ancestors, for which God has sent down no authority. Judgment belongs to none but God. He has commanded that you worship none but Him. This is the right religion, but most people do not know
v.l: Ma Ta`buduna Min Dunihi 'Illa 'Asma'an Sammaytumuha 'Antum Wa 'Aba'uukum Ma 'Anzala Allahu Biha Min Sultanin 'Ini Al-Hukmu 'Illa Lillahi 'Amara 'Alla Ta`budu 'Illa 'Iyahu Dhalika Ad-Dinu Al-Qayyimu Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Ya`lamuna

v.t: “O my fellow inmates! One of you will serve his master wine; while the other will be crucified, and the birds will eat from his head. Thus the matter you are inquiring about is settled.”
v.l: Ya Sahibayi As-Sijni 'Amma 'Ahadukuma Fayasqi Rabbahu Khamraan Wa 'Amma Al-'Akharu Fayuslabu Fata'kulu At-Tayru Min Ra'sihi Quđiya Al-'Amru Al-Ladhi Fihi Tastaftiyani

v.t: And he said to the one he thought would be released, “Mention me to your master.” But Satan caused him to forget mentioning him to his master, so he remained in prison for several years
v.l: Wa Qala Lilladhi Zanna 'Annahu Najin Minhuma Adhkurni `Inda Rabbika Fa'ansahu Ash-Shaytanu Dhikra Rabbihi Falabitha Fi As-Sijni Biđ`a Sinina

v.t: The king said, “I see seven fat cows being eaten by seven lean ones, and seven green spikes, and others dried up. O elders, explain to me my vision, if you are able to interpret visions.”
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Maliku 'Inni 'Ara Sab`a Baqaratin Simanin Ya'kuluhunna Sab`un `Ijafun Wa Sab`a Sunbulatin Khuđrin Wa 'Ukhara Ya Bisatin Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Mala'u 'Aftuni Fi Ru'uya Ya 'In Kuntum Lilrru'uya Ta`buruna

v.t: They said, “Jumbles of dreams, and we know nothing of the interpretation of dreams.”
v.l: Qalu 'Ađghathu 'Ahlamin Wa Ma Nahnu Bita'wili Al-'Ahlami Bi`alimina

v.t: The one who was released said, having remembered after a time, “I will inform you of its interpretation, so send me out.”
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhi Naja Minhuma Wa Aiddakara Ba`da 'Ummatin 'Ana 'Unabbi'ukum Bita'wilihi Fa'arsiluni

v.t: “Joseph, O man of truth, inform us concerning seven fat cows being eaten by seven lean ones, and seven green spikes, and others dried up, so that I may return to the people, so that they may know.”
v.l: Yusufu 'Ayyuha As-Siddiqu 'Aftina Fi Sab`i Baqaratin Simanin Ya'kuluhunna Sab`un `Ijafun Wa Sab`i Sunbulatin Khuđrin Wa 'Ukhara Ya Bisatin La`alli 'Arji`u 'Ila An-Nasi La`allahum Ya`lamuna

v.t: He said, “You will farm for seven consecutive years. But whatever you harvest, leave it in its spikes, except for the little that you eat.”
v.l: Qala Tazra`una Sab`a Sinina Da'abaan Fama Hasadtum Fadharuhu Fi Sunbulihi 'Illa Qalilaan Mimma Ta'kuluna

v.t: Then after that will come seven difficult ones, which will consume what you have stored for them, except for the little that you have preserved
v.l: Thumma Ya'ti Min Ba`di Dhalika Sab`un Shidadun Ya'kulna Ma Qaddamtum Lahunna 'Illa Qalilaan Mimma Tuhsinuna

v.t: Then after that will come a year that brings relief to the people, and during which they will press
v.l: Thumma Ya'ti Min Ba`di Dhalika `Amun Fihi Yughathu An-Nasu Wa Fihi Ya`siruna

v.t: The king said, “Bring him to me.” And when the envoy came to him, he said, “Go back to your master, and ask him about the intentions of the women who cut their hands; my Lord is well aware of their schemes.”
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Maliku A'tuni Bihi Falamma Ja'ahu Ar-Rasulu Qala Arji` 'Ila Rabbika Fas'alhu Ma Balu An-Niswati Al-Lati Qatta`na 'Aydiyahunna 'Inna Rabbi Bikaydihinna `Alimun

v.t: He said, “What was the matter with you, women, when you tried to seduce Joseph?” They said, “God forbid! We knew of no evil committed by him.” The governor’s wife then said, “Now the truth is out. It was I who tried to seduce him, and he is telling the truth.”
v.l: Qala Ma Khatbukunna 'Idh Rawadttunna Yusufa `An Nafsihi Qulna Hasha Lillahi Ma `Alimna `Alayhi Min Su'in Qalati Amra'atu Al-`Azizi Al-'Ana Hashasa Al-Haqqu 'Ana Rawadttuhu `An Nafsihi Wa 'Innahu Lamina As-Sadiqina

v.t: “This is that he may know that I did not betray him in secret, and that God does not guide the scheming of the betrayers.”
v.l: Dhalika Liya`lama 'Anni Lam 'Akhunhu Bil-Ghaybi Wa 'Anna Allaha La Yahdi Kayda Al-Kha'inina

v.t: “Yet I do not claim to be innocent. The soul commands evil, except those on whom my Lord has mercy. Truly my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful.”
v.l: Wa Ma 'Ubarri'u Nafsi 'Inna An-Nafsa La'ammaratun Bis-Su'i 'Illa Ma Rahima Rabbi 'Inna Rabbi Ghafurun Rahimun

v.t: The king said, “Bring him to me, and I will reserve him for myself.” And when he spoke to him, he said, “This day you are with us established and secure.”
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Maliku A'tuni Bihi 'Astakhlishu Linafsi Falamma Kallamahu Qala 'Innaka Al-Yawma Ladayna Makinun 'Aminun

v.t: He said, “Put me in charge of the storehouses of the land; I am honest and knowledgeable.”
v.l: Qala Aj`alni `Ala Khaza'ini Al-'Arđi 'Inni Hafizun `Alimun

v.t: And thus We established Joseph in the land, to live therein wherever he wished. We touch with Our mercy whomever We will, and We never waste the reward of the righteous
v.l: Wa Kadhalika Makkanna Liyusufa Fi Al-'Arđi Yatabawwa'u Minha Haythu Yasha'u Nusibu Birahmatina Man Nasha'u Wa La Nuđi`u 'Ajra Al-Muhsinina

v.t: But the reward of the Hereafter is better for those who believe and observed piety
v.l: Wa La'ajru Al-'Akhirati Khayrun Lilladhina 'Amanu Wa Kanu Yattaquna

v.t: And Joseph's brothers came, and entered into his presence. He recognized them, but they did not recognize him
v.l: Wa Ja'a 'Ikhwatu Yusufa Fadakhalu `Alayhi Fa`arafahum Wa Hum Lahu Munkiruna

v.t: When he provided them with their provisions, he said, “Bring me a brother of yours from your father. Do you not see that I fill up the measure, and I am the best of hosts?”
v.l: Wa Lamma Jahhazahum Bijahazihim Qala A'tuni Bi'akhin Lakum Min 'Abikum 'Ala Tarawna 'Anni 'Ufi Al-Kayla Wa 'Ana Khayru Al-Munzilina

v.t: “But if you do not bring him to me, you will have no measure from me, and you will not come near me.”
v.l: Fa'in Lam Ta'tuni Bihi Fala Kayla Lakum `Indi Wa La Taqrabuni

v.t: They said, “We will solicit him from his father. We will surely do.”
v.l: Qalu Sanurawidu `Anhu 'Abahu Wa 'Inna Lafa`iluna
w: We will try to get permission

v.t: He said to his servants, “Put their goods in their saddlebags; perhaps they will recognize them when they return to their families, and maybe they will come back.”
v.l: Wa Qala Lifityanihi Aj`alu Biđa`atahum Fi Rihalihim La`allahum Ya`rifunaha 'Idha Anqalabu 'Ila 'Ahlihim La`allahum Yarji`una

v.t: When they returned to their father, they said, “O father, we were denied measure, but send our brother with us, and we will obtain measure. We will take care of him.”
v.l: Falamma Raja`u 'Ila 'Abihim Qalu Ya 'Abana Muni`a Minna Al-Kaylu Fa'arsil Ma`ana 'Akhana Naktal Wa 'Inna Lahu Lahafizuna

v.t: He said, “Shall I trust you with him, as I trusted you with his brother before? God is the Best Guardian, and He is the Most Merciful of the merciful.”
v.l: Qala Hal 'Amanukum `Alayhi 'Illa Kama 'Amintukum `Ala 'Akhihi Min Qablu Fa-Allahu Khayrun Hafizaan Wa Huwa 'Arhamu Ar-Rahimina

v.t: And when they opened their baggage, they found that their goods were returned to them. They said, “Father, what more do we want? Here are our goods, returned to us. We will provide for our family, and protect our brother, and have an additional camel-load. This is easy commerce.”
v.l: Wa Lamma Fatahu Mata`ahum Wa Jadu Biđa`atahum Ruddat 'Ilayhim Qalu Ya 'Abana Ma Nabghi Hadhihi Biđa`atuna Ruddat 'Ilayna Wa Namiru 'Ahlana Wa Nahfazu 'Akhana Wa Nazdadu Kayla Ba`irin Dhalika Kaylun Yasirun

v.t: He said, “I will not send him with you, unless you give me a pledge before God that you will bring him back to me, unless you get trapped.” And when they gave him their pledge, he said, “God is witness to what we say.”
v.l: Qala Lan 'Ursilahu Ma`akum Hatta Tu'utuni Mawthiqaan Mina Allahi Lata'tunani Bihi 'Illa 'An Yuhata Bikum Falamma 'Atawhu Mawthiqahum Qala Allahu `Ala Ma Naqulu Wa Kilun
w: that surely you will bring him to me
that surely you will bring him to me

v.t: And he said, “O my sons, do not enter by one gate, but enter by different gates. I cannot avail you anything against God. The decision rests only with God. On Him I rely, and on Him let the reliant rely.”
v.l: Wa Qala Ya Baniya La Tadkhulu Min Babin Wahidin Wa Adkhulu Min 'Abwabin Mutafarriqatin Wa Ma 'Ughni `Ankum Mina Allahi Min Shay'in 'Ini Al-Hukmu 'Illa Lillahi `Alayhi Tawakkaltu Wa `Alayhi Falyatawakkali Al-Mutawakkiluna

v.t: And when they entered as their father had instructed them, it did not avail them anything against God; it was just a need in the soul of Jacob, which he carried out. He was a person of knowledge inasmuch as We had taught him, but most people do not know
v.l: Wa Lamma Dakhalu Min Haythu 'Amarahum 'Abuhum Mma Kana Yughni `Anhum Mmina Allahi Min Shay'in 'Illa Hajatan Fi Nafsi Ya`quba Qađaha Wa 'Innahu Ladhu `Ilmin Lima `Allamnahu Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Ya`lamuna

v.t: And when they entered into the presence of Joseph, he embraced his brother, and said, “I am your brother; do not be saddened by what they used to do.”
v.l: Wa Lamma Dakhalu `Ala Yusufa 'Awa 'Ilayhi 'Akhahu Qala 'Inni 'Ana 'Akhuka Fala Tabta'is Bima Kanu Ya`maluna

v.t: Then, when he provided them with their provisions, he placed the drinking-cup in his brother’s saddlebag. Then an announcer called out, “O people of the caravan, you are thieves.”
v.l: Falamma Jahhazahum Bijahazihim Ja`ala As-Siqayata Fi Rahli 'Akhihi Thumma 'Adhana Mu'uadhinun 'Ayyatuha Al-`Iru 'Innakum Lasariquna

v.t: They said, as they came towards them, “What are you missing?”
v.l: Qalu Wa 'Aqbalu `Alayhim Madha Tafqiduna

v.t: They said, “We are missing the king’s goblet. Whoever brings it will have a camel-load; and I personally guarantee it.”
v.l: Qalu Nafqidu Suwa`a Al-Maliki Wa Liman Ja'a Bihi Himlu Ba`irin Wa 'Ana Bihi Za`imun

v.t: They said, “By God, you know we did not come to cause trouble in the land, and we are not thieves.”
v.l: Qalu Ta-Allahi Laqad `Alimtum Ma Ji'na Linufsida Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Ma Kunna Sariqina

v.t: They said, “What shall be his punishment, if you are lying?”
v.l: Qalu Fama Jaza'uuhu 'In Kuntum Kadhibina

v.t: They said, “His punishment, if it is found in his bag: he will belong to you. Thus we penalize the guilty.”
v.l: Qalu Jaza'uuhu Man Wujida Fi Rahlihi Fahuwa Jaza'uuhu Kadhalika Najzi Az-Zalimina

v.t: So he began with their bags, before his brother's bag. Then he pulled it out of his brother’s bag. Thus We devised a plan for Joseph; he could not have detained his brother under the king’s law, unless God so willed. We elevate by degrees whomever We will; and above every person of knowledge, there is one more learned
v.l: Fabada'a Bi'aw`iyatihim Qabla Wi`a'i 'Akhihi Thumma Astakhrajaha Min Wi`a'i 'Akhihi Kadhalika Kidna Liyusufa Ma Kana Liya'khudha 'Akhahu Fi Dini Al-Maliki 'Illa 'An Yasha'a Allahu Narfa`u Darajatin Man Nasha'u Wa Fawqa Kulli Dhi `Ilmin `Alimun

v.t: They said, “If he has stolen, a brother of his has stolen before.” But Joseph kept it to himself, and did not reveal it to them. He said, “You are in a worse situation, and God is Aware of what you allege.”
v.l: Qalu 'In Yasriq Faqad Saraqa 'Akhun Lahu Min Qablu Fa'asarraha Yusufu Fi Nafsihi Wa Lam Yubdiha Lahum Qala 'Antum Sharrun Makanaan Wa Allahu 'A`lamu Bima Tasifuna

v.t: They said, “O noble prince, he has a father, a very old man, so take one of us in his place. We see that you are a good person.”
v.l: Qalu Ya 'Ayyuha Al-`Azizu 'Inna Lahu 'Abaan Shaykhaan Kabiraan Fakhudh 'Ahadana Makanahu 'Inna Naraka Mina Al-Muhsinina

v.t: He said, “God forbid that we should arrest anyone except him in whose possession we found our property; for then we would be unjust.”
v.l: Qala Ma`adha Allahi 'An Na'khudha 'Illa Man Wajadna Mata`ana `Indahu 'Inna 'Idhaan Lazalimuna

v.t: And when they despaired of him, they conferred privately. Their eldest said, “Don’t you know that your father received a pledge from you before God, and in the past you failed with regard to Joseph? I will not leave this land until my father permits me, or God decides for me; for He is the Best of Deciders.”
v.l: Falamma Astay'asu Minhu Khalasu Najiyaan Qala Kabiruhum 'Alam Ta`lamu 'Anna 'Abakum Qad 'Akhadha `Alaykum Mawthiqaan Mina Allahi Wa Min Qablu Ma Farrattum Fi Yusufa Falan 'Abraha Al-'Arđa Hatta Ya'dhana Li 'Abi 'Aw Yahkuma Allahu Li Wa Huwa Khayru Al-Hakimina

v.t: “Go back to your father, and say, ‘Our father, your son has stolen. We testify only to what we know, and we could not have prevented the unforeseen.’”
v.l: Arji`u 'Ila 'Abikum Faqulu Ya 'Abana 'Inna Abnaka Saraqa Wa Ma Shahidna 'Illa Bima `Alimna Wa Ma Kunna Lilghaybi Hafizina

v.t: “Ask the town where we were, and the caravan in which we came. We are being truthful.”
v.l: Wa As'ali Al-Qaryata Allati Kunna Fiha Wa Al-`Ira Allati 'Aqbalna Fiha Wa 'Inna Lasadiquna

v.t: He said, “Rather, your souls have contrived something for you. Patience is a virtue. Perhaps God will bring them all back to me. He is the Knowing, the Wise.”
v.l: Qala Bal Sawwalat Lakum 'Anfusukum 'Amraan Fasabrun Jamilun `Asa Allahu 'An Ya'tiyani Bihim Jami`aan 'Innahu Huwa Al-`Alimu Al-Hakimu

v.t: Then he turned away from them, and said, “O my bitterness for Joseph.” And his eyes turned white from sorrow, and he became depressed
v.l: Wa Tawalla `Anhum Wa Qala Ya 'Asafa `Ala Yusufa Wa Abyađđat `Aynahu Mina Al-Huzni Fahuwa Kazimun

v.t: They said, “By God, you will not stop remembering Joseph, until you have ruined your health, or you have passed away.”
v.l: Qalu Ta-Allahi Tafta'u Tadhkuru Yusufa Hatta Takuna Harađaan 'Aw Takuna Mina Al-Halikina

v.t: He said, “I only complain of my grief and sorrow to God, and I know from God what you do not know.”
v.l: Qala 'Innama 'Ashku Baththi Wa Huzni 'Ila Allahi Wa 'A`lamu Mina Allahi Ma La Ta`lamuna

v.t: “O my sons, go and inquire about Joseph and his brother, and do not despair of God's comfort. None despairs of God's comfort except the disbelieving people.”
v.l: Ya Baniya Adh/habu Fatahassasu Min Yusufa Wa 'Akhihi Wa La Tay'asu Min Rawhi Allahi 'Innahu La Yay'asu Min Rawhi Allahi 'Illa Al-Qawmu Al-Kafiruna

v.t: Then, when they entered into his presence, they said, “Mighty governor, adversity has befallen us, and our family. We have brought scant merchandise. But give us full measure, and be charitable towards us—God rewards the charitable.”
v.l: Falamma Dakhalu `Alayhi Qalu Ya 'Ayyuha Al-`Azizu Massana Wa 'Ahlana Ađ-Đurru Wa Ji'na Bibiđa`atin Muzjaatin Fa'awfi Lana Al-Kayla Wa Tasaddaq `Alayna 'Inna Allaha Yajzi Al-Mutasaddiqina

v.t: He said, “Do you realize what you did with Joseph and his brother, in your ignorance?”
v.l: Qala Hal `Alimtum Ma Fa`altum Biyusufa Wa 'Akhihi 'Idh 'Antum Jahiluna

v.t: They said, “Is that you, Joseph?” He said, “I am Joseph, and this is my brother. God has been gracious to us. He who practices piety and patience—God never fails to reward the righteous.”
v.l: Qalu 'A'innaka La'anta Yusufu Qala 'Ana Yusufu Wa Hadha 'Akhi Qad Manna Allahu `Alayna 'Innahu Man Yattaqi Wa Yasbir Fa'inna Allaha La Yuđi`u 'Ajra Al-Muhsinina

v.t: They said, “By God, God has preferred you over us. We were definitely in the wrong.”
v.l: Qalu Ta-Allahi Laqad 'Atharaka Allahu `Alayna Wa 'In Kunna Lakhati'ina

v.t: He said, “There is no blame upon you today. God will forgive you. He is the Most Merciful of the merciful.”
v.l: Qala La Tathriba `Alaykumu Al-Yawma Yaghfiru Allahu Lakum Wa Huwa 'Arhamu Ar-Rahimina

v.t: “Take this shirt of mine, and lay it over my father’s face, and he will recover his sight. And bring your whole family to me.”
v.l: Adh/habu Biqamisi Hadha Fa'alquhu `Ala Wajhi 'Abi Ya'ti Basiraan Wa 'Tuni Bi'ahlikum 'Ajma`ina

v.t: As the caravan set out, their father said, “I sense the presence of Joseph, though you may think I am senile.”
v.l: Wa Lamma Fasalati Al-`Iru Qala 'Abuhum 'Inni La'ajidu Riha Yusufa Lawla 'An Tufanniduni
w: you think me weakened in mind

v.t: They said, “By God, you are still in your old confusion.”
v.l: Qalu Ta-Allahi 'Innaka Lafi Đalalika Al-Qadimi

v.t: Then, when the bearer of good news arrived, he laid it over his face, and he regained his sight. He said, “Did I not say to you that I know from God what you do not know?”
v.l: Falamma 'An Ja'a Al-Bashiru 'Alqahu `Ala Wajhihi Fartadda Basiraan Qala 'Alam 'Aqul Lakum 'Inni 'A`lamu Mina Allahi Ma La Ta`lamuna

v.t: They said, “Father, pray for the forgiveness of our sins; we were indeed at fault.”
v.l: Qalu Ya 'Abana Astaghfir Lana Dhunubana 'Inna Kunna Khati'ina

v.t: He said, “I will ask my Lord to forgive you. He is the Forgiver, the Most Merciful.”
v.l: Qala Sawfa 'Astaghfiru Lakum Rabbi 'Innahu Huwa Al-Ghafuru Ar-Rahimu

v.t: Then, when they entered into the presence of Joseph, he embraced his parents, and said, “Enter Egypt, God willing, safe and secure.”
v.l: Falamma Dakhalu `Ala Yusufa 'Awa 'Ilayhi 'Abawayhi Wa Qala Adkhulu Misra 'In Sha'a Allahu 'Aminina

v.t: And he elevated his parents on the throne, and they fell prostrate before him. He said, “Father, this is the fulfillment of my vision of long ago. My Lord has made it come true. He has blessed me, when he released me from prison, and brought you out of the wilderness, after the devil had sown conflict between me and my brothers. My Lord is Most Kind towards whomever He wills. He is the All-knowing, the Most Wise.”
v.l: Wa Rafa`a 'Abawayhi `Ala Al-`Arshi Wa Kharru Lahu Sujjadaan Wa Qala Ya 'Abati Hadha Ta'wilu Ru'uya Y Min Qablu Qad Ja`alaha Rabbi Haqqaan Wa Qad 'Ahsana Bi 'Idh 'Akhrajani Mina As-Sijni Wa Ja'a Bikum Mina Al-Badwi Min Ba`di 'An Nazagha Ash-Shaytanu Bayni Wa Bayna 'Ikhwati 'Inna Rabbi Latifun Lima Yasha'u 'Innahu Huwa Al-`Alimu Al-Hakimu

v.t: “My Lord, You have given me some authority, and taught me some interpretation of events. Initiator of the heavens and the earth; You are my Protector in this life and in the Hereafter. Receive my soul in submission, and unite me with the righteous.”
v.l: Rabbi Qad 'Ataytani Mina Al-Mulki Wa `Allamtani Min Ta'wili Al-'Ahadithi Fatira As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi 'Anta Wa Liyi Fi Ad-Dunya Wa Al-'Akhirati Tawaffani Muslimaan Wa 'Alhiqni Bis-Salihina

v.t: This is news from the past that We reveal to you. You were not present with them when they plotted and agreed on a plan
v.l: Dhalika Min 'Anba'i Al-Ghaybi Nuhihi 'Ilayka Wa Ma Kunta Ladayhim 'Idh 'Ajma`u 'Amrahum Wa Hum Yamkuruna

v.t: But most people, for all your eagerness, are not believers
v.l: Wa Ma 'Aktharu An-Nasi Wa Law Harasta Bimu'uminina

v.t: You ask them no wage for it. It is only a reminder for all mankind
v.l: Wa Ma Tas'aluhum `Alayhi Min 'Ajrin 'In Huwa 'Illa Dhikrun Lil`alamina

v.t: How many a sign in the heavens and the earth do they pass by, paying no attention to them
v.l: Wa Ka'ayyin Min 'Ayatin Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Yamurruna `Alayha Wa Hum `Anha Mu`riđuna

v.t: And most of them do not believe in God unless they associate others
v.l: Wa Ma Yu'uminu 'Aktharuhum Billahi 'Illa Wa Hum Mushrikuna

v.t: Do they feel secure that a covering of God’s punishment will not come upon them, or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly, while they are unaware
v.l: Afa'aminu 'An Ta'tiyahum Ghashiyatun Min `Adhabi Allahi 'Aw Ta'tiyahumu As-Sa`atu Baghtatan Wa Hum La Yash`uruna

v.t: Say, “This is my way; I invite to God, based on clear knowledge—I and whoever follows me. Glory be to God; and I am not of the polytheists.”
v.l: Qul Hadhihi Sabili 'Ad`u 'Ila Allahi `Ala Basiratin 'Ana Wa Mani Attaba`ani Wa Subhana Allahi Wa Ma 'Ana Mina Al-Mushrikina

v.t: We did not send before you except men, whom We inspired, from the people of the towns. Have they not roamed the earth and seen the consequences for those before them? The Home of the Hereafter is better for those who are righteous. Do you not understand
v.l: Wa Ma 'Arsalna Min Qablika 'Illa Rijalaan Nuhi 'Ilayhim Min 'Ahli Al-Qura 'Afalam Yasiru Fi Al-'Arđi Fayanzuru Kayfa Kana `Aqibatu Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Wa Ladaru Al-'Akhirati Khayrun Lilladhina Attaqaw 'Afala Ta`qiluna

v.t: Until, when the messengers have despaired, and thought that they were rejected, Our help came to them. We save whomever We will, and Our severity is not averted from the guilty people
v.l: Hatta 'Idha Astay'asa Ar-Rusulu Wa Zannu 'Annahum Qad Kudhibu Ja'ahum Nasruna Fanujjiya Man Nasha'u Wa La Yuraddu Ba'suna `Ani Al-Qawmi Al-Mujrimina

v.t: In their stories is a lesson for those who possess intelligence. This is not a fabricated tale, but a confirmation of what came before it, and a detailed explanation of all things, and guidance, and mercy for people who believe
v.l: Laqad Kana Fi Qasasihim `Ibratun Li'wli Al-'Albabi Ma Kana Hadithaan Yuftara Wa Lakin Tasdiqa Al-Ladhi Bayna Yadayhi Wa Tafsila Kulli Shay'in Wa Hudaan Wa Rahmatan Liqawmin Yu'uminuna
